sentences.text: It's Saturday evening.
Mr and Mrs Phillips and their children, Roger and Helen, are playing cards in the living room.
sentences.translation: السيد والسيدة فيليبس وأطفالهما، روجر وهيلين، يلعبون الورق في غرفة الجلوس.

sentences.text: Suddenly the telephone rings in the hall.
Mr Phillips gets up and answers it.
When he comes back, he is smiling.
"That was your Aunt Elizabeth.
She's back from Greenland.
She's coming to see us tomorrow morning.
And she's got a surprise for you two."
"A surprise for us!
What is it?" Roger and Helen shout.
"I don't know," says their dad.
"She says that it's a secret.
And now it's time for bed."
"Come on, dad, one more game."
"Oh, okay.
Then straight to bed!"
The next morning the doorbell rings.
sentences.translation: في صباح اليوم التالي يرن جرس الباب.

sentences.text: Roger and Helen run to open the door.
It's Aunt Elizabeth, and she's got a big metal box.
sentences.translation: إنها العمة إليزابيث، ومعها صندوق معدني كبير.

sentences.text: She hugs the children.
Then she opens the box very carefully.
It's full of small pieces of ice.
sentences.translation: إنه مليء بقطع صغيرة من الجليد.

sentences.text: She puts her hand into the ice and she slowly takes out a big egg.
sentences.translation: تضع يدها في الجليد وتخرج ببطء بيضة كبيرة.

sentences.text: "This egg is from an ice cave in Greenland.
sentences.translation: "هذه البيضة من كهف جليدي في غرينلاند.

sentences.text: It's very special.
Now I need your help."
"What do you want us to do?" ask the children.
"I want to see what happens when we put the egg in a warm place.
sentences.translation: "أريد أن أرى ما يحدث عندما نضع البيضة في مكان دافئ.

sentences.text: There is no heating in my office at the museum during the summer," says Aunt Elizabeth.
sentences.translation: لا توجد تدفئة في مكتبي في المتحف خلال الصيف"، تقول العمة إليزابيث.

sentences.text: "I thought I could leave it here."
"Yippee!
An experiment!" shout the children.
They get a cardboard box and put the egg inside.
sentences.translation: يحضرون صندوقاً من الكرتون ويضعون البيضة بداخله.

sentences.text: Then they put the box next to the radiator in the kitchen.
sentences.translation: ثم يضعون الصندوق بجانب المدفأة في المطبخ.

sentences.text: Aunt Elizabeth comes to check the egg every day but nothing happens.
sentences.translation: تأتي العمة إليزابيث لتفقد البيضة كل يوم لكن لا شيء يحدث.

sentences.text: Then, one day while the children are having their breakfast, they hear a noise.
sentences.translation: ثم، في أحد الأيام بينما يتناول الأطفال فطورهم، يسمعون ضجة.

sentences.text: "Look at the egg," shouts Helen.
"Something's happening.
It's cracking."
Slowly a long beak appears.
"It's a bird," says Roger.
"No, it isn't," answers Helen.
"It hasn't got any feathers."
"Of course it's a bird, stupid.
Baby birds haven't got feathers."
The animal opens its beak.
"Let's give it a sausage," says Roger.
Helen gives a sausage to the animal.
The animal is very hungry.
It eats five sausages, two cooked tomatoes and six pieces of toast.
sentences.translation: يأكل خمسة سجق، وحبتين من الطماطم المطبوخة، وست قطع من الخبز المحمص.

sentences.text: A month later, the family are having dinner.
"That thing's growing very fast," says mum.
sentences.translation: "هذا الشيء ينمو بسرعة كبيرة"، تقول أمي.

sentences.text: "And it's always very hungry," answers Helen.
"Roger thinks that it's a bird, but I don't think so.
sentences.translation: "يعتقد روجر أنه طائر، لكنني لا أعتقد ذلك.

sentences.text: It still hasn't got any feathers."
sentences.translation: لا يزال ليس لديه أي ريش."

sentences.text: "What does Aunt Elizabeth say?" asks mum.
"I don't know, she's away on another trip and she isn't coming back for a few weeks."
sentences.translation: "لا أعرف، إنها في رحلة أخرى ولن تعود لبضعة أسابيع."

sentences.text: "Let's check what it is," dad says and gets up.
At that moment, the animal spreads its wings, flies over to the table and grabs dad's fish.
sentences.translation: في تلك اللحظة، ينشر الحيوان جناحيه، ويطير إلى الطاولة ويسرق سمكة أبي.

sentences.text: The children laugh.
Mum is not so happy.
"Get off the table," she shouts.
Dad goes to his computer.
"Hey, come and look!
I know what it is!
It's a pterodactyl."
"A pterodactyl?" shout the children.
"Yes, they lived a long, long time ago.
sentences.translation: "نعم، لقد عاشوا منذ زمن طويل جداً.

sentences.text: They're a type of dinosaur.
Pterodactyls can fly."
"Yes, we know that, dad," say the children and laugh.
sentences.translation: "نعم، نعلم ذلك يا أبي"، يقول الأطفال ويضحكون.

sentences.text: Dad sits down at the table.
"Where's my fish?" he asks.
"Look at Dacty, dad.
He's got it." Helen says.
"Now he's got a name," says mum.
"Dacty sounds nice.
It suits him."
A few days later, the children are in Helen's room.
sentences.translation: بعد بضعة أيام، يكون الأطفال في غرفة هيلين.

sentences.text: "What are you doing with the bandage?" asks Roger.
"There is something wrong with Dacty's wing.
My room is too small and he keeps banging his wings against the walls and furniture.
sentences.translation: غرفتي صغيرة جداً وهو يخبط بجناحيه على الجدران والأثاث.

sentences.text: He can't fly.
I feel sorry for him.
And he is always hungry.
Can you get something for him from the kitchen?"
sentences.translation: هل يمكنك إحضار شيء له من المطبخ؟"

sentences.text: Roger goes into the kitchen and cooks a big plate of sausages.
sentences.translation: يذهب روجر إلى المطبخ ويطبخ طبقاً كبيراً من السجق.

sentences.text: Helen helps Dacty down from her wardrobe.
sentences.translation: تساعد هيلين دكتي على النزول من خزانتها.

sentences.text: Roger puts the plate with the sausages in front of Dacty and the pterodactyl quickly eats them all up.
sentences.translation: يضع روجر الطبق مع السجق أمام دكتي ويأكل التيروداكتيل كل شيء بسرعة.

sentences.text: Then he tries to fly on to the top of Helen's wardrobe, but he can't.
sentences.translation: ثم يحاول الطيران إلى أعلى خزانة هيلين، لكنه لا يستطيع.

sentences.text: "Mum, we have to take Dacty to a vet.
sentences.translation: "أمي، يجب أن نأخذ دكتي إلى طبيب بيطري.

sentences.text: He can't fly.
There's something wrong with his wing.
Can you take us?"
"All right.
Put him into the big basket."
"And mum, don't tell the vet that he is a pterodactyl," says Helen.
sentences.translation: "وأمي، لا تخبري الطبيب البيطري أنه تيروداكتيل"، تقول هيلين.

sentences.text: "We don't want people to find out we've got a dinosaur in our house.
sentences.translation: "لا نريد أن يكتشف الناس أن لدينا ديناصوراً في منزلنا.

sentences.text: There'll be stories in all the newspapers."
sentences.translation: ستكون هناك قصص في جميع الصحف."

sentences.text: "Okay, I won't say a word," says mum.
When they get to the surgery, the vet looks very carefully at Dacty.
sentences.translation: عندما يصلون إلى العيادة، ينظر الطبيب البيطري بعناية فائقة إلى دكتي.

sentences.text: "The wing is not broken, but it needs rest.
sentences.translation: "الجناح غير مكسور، لكنه يحتاج إلى راحة.

sentences.text: I'll put a splint on it and it will be better soon.
But what sort of bird is this?
sentences.translation: لكن أي نوع من الطيور هذا؟

sentences.text: What happened to his feathers?"
"Oh, he's a special turkey from South America, and they don't have feathers," says Roger.
sentences.translation: "أوه، إنه ديك رومي مميز من أمريكا الجنوبية، وليس لديهم ريش"، يقول روجر.

sentences.text: "Oh, yes, of course," says the vet.
But she looks a little confused.
Two weeks later Dacty's wing is better.
Helen and Roger want to see if he can fly.
sentences.translation: تريد هيلين وروجر رؤية ما إذا كان يستطيع الطيران.

sentences.text: They wait until it is dark and they take Dacty outside into the garden in a big basket.
sentences.translation: ينتظرون حتى يحل الظلام ويأخذون دكتي إلى الخارج في الحديقة في سلة كبيرة.

sentences.text: "Come on Dacty, now you can really fly," says Helen.
sentences.translation: "هيا يا دكتي، الآن يمكنك الطيران حقاً"، تقول هيلين.

sentences.text: But Dacty doesn't want to get out of the basket.
sentences.translation: لكن دكتي لا يريد الخروج من السلة.

sentences.text: He is holding his blanket in his beak.
"I think he's cold," says Roger.
"I don't think so," says Helen.
"He's afraid."
Helen and Roger take Dacty out of the basket.
sentences.translation: تخرج هيلين وروجر دكتي من السلة.

sentences.text: Roger climbs a tree.
"Come on, Dacty," he shouts.
But Dacty quickly climbs back into the basket taking his blanket with him.
sentences.translation: لكن دكتي يعود بسرعة إلى السلة آخذاً بطانيته معه.

sentences.text: "Let's take him back into the house and phone Aunt Elizabeth.
She came back yesterday," Helen says.
The children phone Aunt Elizabeth.
They tell her that Dacty can't fly in Helen's room and he doesn't want to fly in the garden.
sentences.translation: يخبرونها أن دكتي لا يستطيع الطيران في غرفة هيلين ولا يريد الطيران في الحديقة.

sentences.text: Aunt Elizabeth tells them that pterodactyls lived at a time when it was very warm.
sentences.translation: تخبرهم العمة إليزابيث أن التيروداكتيل عاش في وقت كان الجو فيه دافئاً جداً.

sentences.text: "There were jungles everywhere.
Even in Greenland.
So I think he likes warm temperatures," she says.
sentences.translation: لذا أعتقد أنه يحب درجات الحرارة الدافئة"، تقول.

sentences.text: "But he can't fly in the house.
He's too big now and mum hates him flying around," says Roger.
sentences.translation: لقد أصبح كبيراً جداً وأمي تكره طيرانه في الأرجاء"، يقول روجر.

sentences.text: "We need to find somewhere else to keep him."
sentences.translation: "نحتاج إلى إيجاد مكان آخر لإبقائه فيه."

sentences.text: "Don't worry.
I'll think of something," answers Aunt Elizabeth.
sentences.translation: سأفكر في شيء ما"، تجيب العمة إليزابيث.

sentences.text: An hour later, she phones Roger and Helen.
"I've got an idea," she says.
"Get Dacty ready.
I'll pick you up in half an hour."
Half an hour later Aunt Elizabeth arrives in her car.
sentences.translation: بعد نصف ساعة تصل العمة إليزابيث بسيارتها.

sentences.text: The children take Dacty and sit in the back of the car with him.
sentences.translation: يأخذ الأطفال دكتي ويجلسون في المقعد الخلفي للسيارة معه.

sentences.text: "Where are we going, Aunt Elizabeth?" they ask.
sentences.translation: "إلى أين نحن ذاهبون يا عمة إليزابيث؟" يسألون.

sentences.text: "To the museum.
My office is very big.
It's perfect for Dacty during the day.
And at night, when the museum is empty, Dacty can fly around and look at all the wonderful things we have.
sentences.translation: وفي الليل، عندما يكون المتحف فارغاً، يمكن لدكتي أن يطير ويلقي نظرة على كل الأشياء الرائعة التي لدينا.

sentences.text: I can't believe I didn't think of it before!"
sentences.translation: لا أصدق أنني لم أفكر في ذلك من قبل!"

sentences.text: "What will he eat?" asks Helen.
"There's a restaurant in the museum.
The cook, Mrs Robinson, is my friend.
I can ask her to feed Dacty."
sentences.translation: يمكنني أن أطلب منها إطعام دكتي."

sentences.text: At the museum, they take Dacty out of the basket.
sentences.translation: في المتحف، يخرجون دكتي من السلة.

sentences.text: He stretches his wings and hops on top of a stone lion.
sentences.translation: يمد جناحيه ويقفز فوق أسد حجري.

sentences.text: "Can he see in the dark?" asks Roger.
sentences.translation: "هل يمكنه الرؤية في الظلام؟" يسأل روجر.

sentences.text: "Yes, they see very well in the dark, just like owls", explains Aunt Elizabeth.
sentences.translation: "نعم، إنهم يرون جيداً في الظلام، تماماً مثل البوم"، تشرح العمة إليزابيث.

sentences.text: "Look," shouts Helen.
Dacty takes off and flies high up.
Then he lands on a stone statue.
Aunt Elizabeth takes some sandwiches out of her bag.
sentences.translation: تخرج العمة إليزابيث بعض السندويشات من حقيبتها.

sentences.text: She holds them out to Dacty.
The pterodactyl flies down and takes them.
Then he flies up to the top of the statue again.
sentences.translation: ثم يطير مرة أخرى إلى أعلى التمثال.

sentences.text: "He likes it here," says Helen.
"Bye, Dacty," they shout.
"See you tomorrow."
Six months pass and Dacty is very big now.
sentences.translation: تمر ستة أشهر ودكتي أصبح كبيراً جداً الآن.

sentences.text: During the day, he sleeps in Aunt Elizabeth's office and at night, he flies around the museum.
sentences.translation: خلال النهار، ينام في مكتب العمة إليزابيث وفي الليل، يطير في أرجاء المتحف.

sentences.text: But one night something strange happens.
sentences.translation: لكن في إحدى الليالي يحدث شيء غريب.

sentences.text: At midnight, Dacty sees lights moving inside the museum.
sentences.translation: في منتصف الليل، يرى دكتي أضواء تتحرك داخل المتحف.

sentences.text: He flies closer to see what is happening.
There are two men with torches inside the museum.
They are wearing masks and they are trying to open a case.
sentences.translation: يرتديان أقنعة ويحاولان فتح صندوق زجاجي.

sentences.text: Inside the case, there is a mummy.
Suddenly one man looks up and sees the pterodactyl.
sentences.translation: فجأة يرفع أحد الرجال رأسه ويرى التيروداكتيل.

sentences.text: He is very scared.
"Look, Bert," he says to the other man.
"There is a huge bird up there."
The other man looks up, but Dacty doesn't move.
sentences.translation: يرفع الرجل الآخر رأسه، لكن دكتي لا يتحرك.

sentences.text: "Shut up, Eric.
Don't be silly.
It's only a statue," the man says.
"Come on.
I'll open the case.
You look for the gold medallions."
While Bert tries to open the case, Dacty flies down and grabs Eric.
sentences.translation: بينما يحاول بيرت فتح الصندوق، يطير دكتي إلى الأسفل ويمسك بإريك.

sentences.text: The thief is so scared that he can't say a thing.
sentences.translation: اللص خائف جداً لدرجة أنه لا يستطيع قول أي شيء.

sentences.text: Dacty flies up and leaves him on top of a statue.
sentences.translation: يطير دكتي إلى الأعلى ويتركه فوق تمثال.

sentences.text: He's stuck.
Bert is so busy opening the case that he doesn't see what is happening.
sentences.translation: بيرت مشغول جداً بفتح الصندوق لدرجة أنه لا يرى ما يحدث.

sentences.text: "Hey, where's the drill?" he says, but there is no answer.
sentences.translation: "هي، أين المثقاب؟" يقول، لكن لا يوجد جواب.

sentences.text: "Eric?
Where are you, Eric?" he asks.
Then he looks up and sees his friend high above on the statue.
sentences.translation: ثم يرفع رأسه ويرى صديقه عالياً فوق التمثال.

sentences.text: Just then Dacty flies down again and grabs the second thief.
sentences.translation: في تلك اللحظة يطير دكتي إلى الأسفل مرة أخرى ويمسك باللص الثاني.

sentences.text: He lifts him in his beak and carries him up to the statue.
The two men are very afraid.
They start shouting, but there is nobody there to hear them.
sentences.translation: يبدآن بالصراخ، لكن لا يوجد أحد هناك ليسمعهما.

sentences.text: In the morning when Aunt Elizabeth comes into the museum, she hears the men shouting.
sentences.translation: في الصباح عندما تدخل العمة إليزابيث إلى المتحف، تسمع الرجال يصرخون.

sentences.text: Then she sees the broken mummy case.
"Help!
Help!
There's a monster in here," the men shout while Dacty flies down to her.
sentences.translation: هناك وحش هنا"، يصرخ الرجال بينما يطير دكتي نحوها.

sentences.text: "First things first."
Aunt Elizabeth says.
She goes into the restaurant, opens the door of the fridge and takes out some fish.
sentences.translation: تدخل إلى المطعم، وتفتح باب الثلاجة وتخرج بعض السمك.

sentences.text: "Here you are, Dacty," she says and pets his head.
sentences.translation: "ها أنت ذا يا دكتي"، تقول وتربت على رأسه.

sentences.text: "Here's your breakfast.
Thank you very much, you did a great job."
sentences.translation: شكراً جزيلاً، لقد قمت بعمل رائع."

sentences.text: Then she phones the police.
The mayor shakes Dacty's wing and puts a big shiny medal over his head.
sentences.translation: يصافح العمدة جناح دكتي ويضع ميدالية كبيرة لامعة فوق رأسه.

sentences.text: "Congratulations, you did a great job."
Then he turns to Aunt Elizabeth, "What a great idea to have a big bird as a guard."
sentences.translation: ثم يستدير نحو العمة إليزابيث، "يا لها من فكرة رائعة أن يكون لديك طائر كبير كحارس."

sentences.text: "Dacty's not a bird," Roger says, "He's a pterodactyl."
"Roger!" says Helen.
"Don't say anything!"
"It doesn't matter, children," says Aunt Elizabeth.
sentences.translation: "لا يهم يا أطفال"، تقول العمة إليزابيث.

sentences.text: "Dacty is a hero now."
"A pterodactyl?" shouts another man.
"Wow!
They love warm weather and jungles.
I work in the Botanical Gardens.
We have a wonderful Palm House.
It's big and warm and just like a jungle.
sentences.translation: إنه كبير ودافئ تماماً مثل الأدغال.

sentences.text: Your pterodactyl will love it there.
sentences.translation: سوف يحب التيروداكتيل الخاص بك ذلك المكان.

sentences.text: We can feed him well and you can come to visit when you want."
sentences.translation: يمكننا إطعامه جيداً ويمكنكما القدوم للزيارة متى أردتما."

sentences.text: So now, Dacty is living in the Palm House at the Botanical Gardens.
sentences.translation: والآن، يعيش دكتي في بيت النخيل في الحدائق النباتية.

sentences.text: Roger and Helen visit him every day after school and bring him nice things to eat.
sentences.translation: يزوره روجر وهيلين كل يوم بعد المدرسة ويحضران له أشياء لذيذة ليأكلها.

sentences.text: One evening Aunt Elizabeth comes with them.
sentences.translation: في إحدى الأمسيات تأتي العمة إليزابيث معهما.

sentences.text: "I'm going to Greenland again," she says.
"I want to look for another egg in the ice.
sentences.translation: "أريد البحث عن بيضة أخرى في الجليد.

sentences.text: If I find the right egg maybe we can find a girlfriend for Dacty."
sentences.translation: إذا وجدت البيضة المناسبة ربما يمكننا إيجاد صديقة لدكتي."

sentences.text: "And then we can have some baby Dacties, too!" shout the children.
sentences.translation: "وبعد ذلك يمكن أن يكون لدينا بعض صغار دكتي أيضاً!" يصرخ الأطفال.

sentences.text: "Can we come, too?" they ask.
Aunt Elizabeth smiles but she shakes her head.
sentences.translation: تبتسم العمة إليزابيث لكنها تهز رأسها.

sentences.text: "Okay, Aunt Elizabeth," say the children.
"Don't worry, Dacty.
We'll stay with you!"
- THE END -
Hope you have enjoyed the reading!
sentences.translation: أتمنى أن تكون قد استمتعت بالقراءة!
